findings.claim: Mark is listed under Names in this verse at all 11 indexed occurrences; 11 name neighbors include Absalom, Amnon, Israel and Job.
findings.reason: All 11 occurrences were contextually reviewed. Six are imperative verbs meaning observe/hearken; five denote a person. The four Mark edges to Absalom, Amnon, Israel and Job each have one supporting verse, but the matched Mark is a verb. The case-sensitive whole-name matcher and shared-verse counts are mechanically correct. The personal-name implication is unsupported. The existing note caveat limits each node to a spelling and does not assert kinship or a meeting.

The node already correctly disclaims disambiguated identity; this is a limitation of its aggregation, not an asserted false identity.

findings.reason: Genesis names Jacob Israel; Exodus describes his descendants, their households, and their increase. Edges derived from children of Israel must not be read as personal meetings with Jacob.

findings.claim: Jesus node has no occurrence link to Matthew 1:21 or 1:25 because their text spells the name JESUS.
findings.reason: The exporter detects exact case-sensitive dictionary spellings. Both PDF passages identify the same name but the imported model lists no names for these two verses. limitations: Bounded identity/gloss review only; does not classify OpenBible cross-reference records.
Only Mark's entire occurrence set was contextually reviewed. Other node identities were examined through the exact listed passages, not all occurrences.
Dictionary unsupported means KJV-only grounding not established in the reviewed passages, not demonstrated lexical falsity or an exhaustive proof of absence elsewhere in the Bible.
Quotations and physical one-based PDF pages come from the parent-prepared pypdf extraction audit-context.json. No independent page image rendering was performed in this subtask.
Existing spelling-node disclaimer is present and prevents treating aggregation as an explicit assertion of identical persons, kinship, or meetings.
No network, scripture, source dictionary, or version files were altered.
